title: Merkle-batched hash verification contract (L16)
description: Invariants for batched Merkle-tree hash verification of raw MAGMA events. See ADR-028.

invariants.name: fixed_batch_size
invariants.description: batch_size=1024 events per Merkle batch. Constant across profiles.
must: batch_size value read from this contract, not hardcoded in Python
small and large profiles use the same batch_size
verification math (log2(batch_size) = 10 proof hashes) is profile-uniform

invariants.name: sha256_hash_function
invariants.description: Leaf hashes (per-event) and interior hashes use sha256. No SHA-1, no truncation.
must: leaf_hash = sha256(event_canonical_bytes)
parent_hash = sha256(left_hash_bytes || right_hash_bytes)
leaf and interior hashes are 32 bytes each (full sha256 output)
no truncation to 16 bytes or alternative hash

invariants.name: canonical_pair_concatenation
invariants.description: Parent hash from two children uses left || right concatenation of raw 32-byte hashes. Documented bit-for-bit.
must: concatenation order is left FIRST, right SECOND
no separator byte, no length prefix
two independent implementations of the spec produce identical root

invariants.name: odd_leaf_padding
invariants.description: When a batch has fewer than batch_size events (last partial batch), pad with sha256(empty byte string) leaves.
must: pad applied to right-fill batch to batch_size
padding policy is operator-visible in audit log when applied

invariants.name: root_stored_on_batch_close
invariants.description: A batch's root hash is written EXACTLY ONCE, when the batch closes (1024 events accumulated OR snapshot rotation forces flush). No re-compute on read.
must: batch close trigger 1: event count reaches batch_size
batch close trigger 2: snapshot-rotation flush forces partial batch close
no re-computation of root_hash on subsequent reads
writer responsible for atomicity: root written + chain marker advance in same transaction

invariants.name: per_event_proof_path
invariants.description: Verifying a specific event reads its batch root + log2(batch_size) sibling hashes, then recomputes path. No global merge of all roots.
must: walker identifies batch via event_index // batch_size
proof length = log2(batch_size) = 10 sibling hashes for batch_size=1024
each batch verifies independently -- no cross-batch chain

invariants.name: mismatch_fails_closed
invariants.description: Any root or proof mismatch triggers raw-replay fallback per ADR-021. This ADR specifies verification mechanism only; fallback decision is unchanged.
must: root_hash mismatch -> raw replay fallback (per ADR-021 fallback_contract.hash_mismatch)
per-event proof mismatch -> raw replay fallback
log WARNING with batch_index + event_index on mismatch

out_of_scope: Cross-batch global Merkle (explicitly NOT planned for L16)
Hash function migration to SHA-3 (future ADR if requirements change)
